title: We’ve been to Disney World in Orlando Florida… and yes, it was magical. ✨But Shanghai Disneyland…
description:
We’ve been to Disney World in Orlando Florida… and yes, it was magical. ✨

But Shanghai Disneyland… 🇨🇳🏰

It shocked us. In the best way.

At Walt Disney World, you get FOUR theme parks in one resort. It opened in 1971 and sits on about 25,000 acres. It’s basically its own city. The history, the nostalgia, the classic castle vibes… it’s iconic. 🤍

Then we visited Shanghai Disneyland.

First fact. The Enchanted Storybook Castle in Shanghai is the BIGGEST Disney castle in the world. And it represents all the princesses, not just one. When our kids saw it, they literally froze. 🏰

Second fact. TRON Lightcycle Power Run was built in Shanghai first. Many Disney fans say this version is faster and more intense than the one in Florida. It feels like you’re actually inside the movie. 🚀

Third fact. Pirates of the Caribbean in Shanghai is completely different from Orlando. It uses massive projection screens and advanced ride tech that Disney Imagineers called a breakthrough in theme park design.

Fun trivia. Shanghai Disneyland opened in 2016 and cost around 5.5 billion US dollars to build. It was designed specially to reflect Chinese culture, which is why the food, shows and storytelling feel different from the US parks. 🍜

So which one is better?

Orlando feels nostalgic.
Shanghai feels futuristic.

But the real magic in both places?

Watching our kids believe. Watching them run toward the castle. Watching them hold our hands when fireworks start. 🥹✨

That’s the memory that stays.

If you had to choose, which one is on your family bucket list?
